create_ResultDiffs: create a ResultDiffs object from a tensor of differences to compute rmse, bias, and variance
create_EstimatorResults: create an EstimatorResults collection and append EstimatorResult objects from experimental runs
report_EstimatorResults: report aggregated statistics from EstimatorResults including mean rewards and diffs between estimates and ground truth

report_results_Evaluator: print a summary report of all estimator results including log, target, and ground truth rewards
